name: 鄭建科
objective:
本課程聚焦於研究設計練習，並以建築與都市設計領域為範疇。課程將引導學生進行研究早期階段事務之形成或轉型： (1) 研究問題； (2) 研究認識論 / 思考架構； (3) 設計研究流程； (4) 研究計畫書； (5) 研究計畫書與進度之溝通與呈現； (6) 現場、簡報、海報發表之實務。
This course focus on the practice of the research design of architecture and urban design. It is to guide the graduate students on the formation or transformation of the issues of early phase of research: (1) Research question; (2) Research problematics / structure of thinking; (3) Design of research procedure; (4) Draft of research proposal; (5) Communications and presentation of research proposal and progress; (6) Practice of on-stage, slide and poster presentation.

延伸教學與資源:
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
